system_prompt: You are assisting with a factual question about Thai law. State which provision applies and what it requires. Answer in English.
prompt: In June 2024, what wording did Section 1567(2) of the Thai Civil and Commercial Code, as then in force, use to define the limits of punishing a child? Quote the wording.
raw_response:
In June 2024, the relevant provision is **Section 1567(2) of the Thai Civil and Commercial Code**.

This provision grants the person exercising parental power the right "to punish the child in a reasonable manner for the purpose of discipline".
